name: coolify
description: Read or change your Coolify instance (projects, applications, deployments) through its API, using the url and apiKey plugin options.

url.title: Coolify URL
url.description: Your instance's https address, such as https://coolify.example.com (or https://app.coolify.io for Coolify Cloud). The apiKey is sent only there. Leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.

apiKey.title: Coolify API token
apiKey.description: A token from Keys & Tokens > API tokens. Give it only the permissions you want Claude to have (read, deploy, write) and leave out read:sensitive. Leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.
